resources.string: Lets home gestures lock the screen, take a screenshot, open recent apps or the power menu. If you turn on the digital wellbeing strict block, it sends you home when you open a paused app: to do that it only checks which app is in the foreground. Dot Launcher doesn\'t read the screen content and doesn\'t collect data.
Dot-matrix scenes: black hole, live weather, dot wave. Pick the scene in Dot Launcher › Wallpapers.
